parsed.rationale: Both `ShowContainerProtocol` (in `_Plant_ShowContainer.swift`) and `TrackContainerProtocol` (in `_Plant_TrackContainer.swift`) within the `Playback` package share three identical members — `isStale:Bool`, `lastRefreshedAt:Date?`, and `pageToken:String?` — and differ only in the concrete type of their `item` field (`Show` vs `Track`). This is the canonical PAT pattern: a single generic protocol with `associatedtype Item` captures the shared shape, while the `item: Item` requirement varies per conformer. Neither record carries any restraint markers (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so no intentional-duplication override applies. Introducing `ContainerProtocol` with `associatedtype Item` eliminates the structural duplication and makes the relationship between the two container protocols explicit and type-safe.
